page.orientation.note: ledger row: page.orientation — Orientation ▾ Landscape swaps the portrait 11906x16838 twips via applyPageOrientationPreset -> writePageSetupMarker (editor.js:6367), which creates the div.page-setup marker with the swapped w/h plus data-orient

page.breaks.note: ledger row: page.breaks — Breaks ▾ 'Insert page break' (identical data-i18n trigger in the insert and layout tabs; the pre opens the first = insert tab's list, matching the ledger binding tab:insert) inserts div.page-break + trailing p via execCommand insertHTML (editor.js:1180)

page.wrapping.note: ledger row: page.wrapping — OO control is disabled until an object is selected; the ctx-menu-on-image pre sets lastObjectPick (editor.js:3815) so applyObjectOp('wrap-square') lands on it: obj-square class + data-wrap attribute (editor.js:3581). The trigger->post chain opens the hidden Wrapping dropdown first (runner has a single pre)

page.align.note: ledger row: page.align — Align ▾ Align center needs a selected object (ctx-menu-on-image pre sets lastObjectPick); applyObjectOp align-* adds obj-center (editor.js:3616)

page.group.note: ledger row: page.group — Group is a visible layout ribbon button (data-cmd=objectOp data-value=group); groupSelectedObjects (editor.js:3414) needs >=2 sibling img/div.object in one parent, which the shift+click two-objects pre provides; wraps them into div.object-group

page.merge-shapes.note: ledger row: page.merge-shapes — Merge shapes ▾ Union stamps data-merge-op on the selected object (editor.js:3640); needs only one object pick, seeded by the ctx-menu-on-image pre; trigger->post chain opens the hidden dropdown

page.custom-columns.note: ledger row: page.custom-columns — Columns ▾ 'Custom columns' (data-cmd=openColumnsDialog, editor.js:1549) opens the same #columns-dialog as the visible Columns ribbon button

table.table-of-contents.note: ledger row: table.table-of-contents — References 'Update TOC' (data-cmd=updateToc -> openUpdateTocDialog, editor.js:9332) opens the whole-table vs page-numbers-only choice dialog

table.table-of-figures.note: ledger row: table.table-of-figures — References 'Table of figures' (data-cmd=insertTableOfFigures) runs the live insertTableOfFiguresCommand (editor.js:7866, later definition wins) -> openOverlayDialog('tableoffigures-dialog')

protect.protect-document.note: ledger row: protect.protect-document — PROMOTED 2026-11-07: the Protect Document toggle (data-cmd=restrictEditing, editor.js:8360 toggleRestrictEditing) POSTs api('protect'); document_protect (editor_docs.rs) now resolves the body through the same demo_or_stored fallback its GET sibling document_protect_state uses, so the unstored demo.docx no longer 404s — the response's restrict_editing:true drives applyProtectionView to editor.contentEditable=false (viewport-flag). The demo doc stays ephemeral (no store write-back), so later page loads boot editable again. Old honest-gap note: POST required store.get_content and showed 'protection failed' for the demo doc

view.zoom-to-100.note: ledger row: view.zoom-to-100 — OO 'Zoom to 100%' binds to the statusbar #btn-zoom-reset; the click handler pins zoomLevel=1 and applyZoom (editor.js:10415/9527) writes editor.style.zoom='1' plus the 100% statusbar label

statusbar.btn-zoom-topage.note: ledger row: statusbar.btn-zoom-topage — PROMOTED 2026-11-08 (L2N-03): OO fit-to-page maps to the single statusbar #btn-zoom-fit; at the runner's 1600px viewport the handler zoomLevel=(1600-96)/830=1.812 -> applyZoom writes '181%' into #sb-zoom-label (editor.js:10641). Order-independent on both sides now: the zoom-reset pre (contract-runner.cjs) drops any persisted wo-zoom and reloads, so the row boots at a distinct '100%' label — the 181% hit proves the fit click ran no matter what earlier contracts left in localStorage — and the new cleanup hook clicks #btn-zoom-reset AFTER the effect check, restoring wo-zoom=1 so the downstream relative-zoom contracts (view-flags btn-zoom-out 1->0.9, btn-zoom-in 0.9->1) keep their fresh-zoom premise. Old honest-gap reason: applyZoom persisted 1.81 and broke zoom-down/up, and `post` could not reset it because post runs before the effect check

statusbar.btn-zoom-towidth.note: ledger row: statusbar.btn-zoom-towidth — PROMOTED 2026-11-08 (L2N-03): same single WO control as btn-zoom-topage (#btn-zoom-fit fits the page width into the viewport, editor.js:10641; deterministic 181% at 1600px); same order-independence fix: zoom-reset pre boots the row at a clean 100% label and the cleanup hook restores wo-zoom=1 after the check, so neither row depends on nor disturbs the neighbouring zoom contracts

plugins.highlight-code.note: ledger row: plugins.highlight-code — the Plugins tab 'Highlight code' card (data-cmd=code) runs toggleMonospace (editor.js:847): styleWithCSS + execCommand fontName Consolas wraps the word under the caret in a span style font-family:Consolas; the plugins menu item (first [data-cmd=code] in DOM) stays hidden, hence the scoped .plugin-card selector

headerfooter.field.note: ledger row: headerfooter.field — Field button (references tab, editor.js:13176) opens #field-dialog (PAGE/DATE/TIME/AUTHOR/FILENAME/WORDS select + insert/cancel actions)

headerfooter.close.note: ledger row: headerfooter.close — PROMOTED 2026-11-07: the hf-editing pre (contract-runner.cjs) plants a .page-header fixture and dblclicks it, running enterHFMode (editor.js:9661) which reveals the contextual tab; #btn-hf-close (editor.js:9681-9682) then runs exitHFMode(false), which exits directly (hfHasUnsavedChanges is false after a fresh enter, so no confirm dialog) and re-hides the tab (hfTab.hidden=true, editor.js:9648-9660); viewport-flag reads the restored hidden content attribute (getAttribute -> "") because the runner's hasClass path has no negative form

chart.wrapping.note: ledger row: chart.wrapping — the ledger binds OO chart-tab Wrapping to the same layout Wrapping menu (tab:layout); the ctx-menu-on-chart pre selects the chart vector object (lastObjectPick) so applyObjectOp('wrap-square') wraps the chart img itself (data-wrap on #fixture-chart); trigger->post chain opens the hidden dropdown

chart.width.note: ledger row: chart.width — PROMOTED 2026-11-06: dialog-input fills #chart-width-input and clicks the Apply size button (data-cmd=chartSize -> applyChartSize, editor.js:1523), which writes spec.width into the data-spec JSON; the old xfail premise (click-only trigger + [data-width] attribute) was stale on both counts

chart.height.note: ledger row: chart.height — PROMOTED 2026-11-06: dialog-input fills #chart-height-input + Apply size (chartSize -> applyChartSize writes spec.height into data-spec); same stale-premise fix as chart.width
